import csv

def parse(text: str) -> list[list[str]]:
    reader = csv.reader(text.splitlines(keepends=True))
    return [row for row in reader if row]

tests = [
    "a,b,c",
    "a,b\nc,d\n",
    "a,b\n\nc,d",
    "a,,c",
    "a,b\r\nc,d\r\n",
    "\"Smith, John\",42\n\"multi\nline\",\"say \"\"hi\"\"\"\n"
]
for t in tests:
    print(repr(t), "=>", parse(t))

import csv
import io

def parse(text: str) -> list[list[str]]:
    f = io.StringIO(text)
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    return [row for row in reader if row]

tests = [
    "a,b,c",
    "a,b\nc,d\n",
    "a,b\n\nc,d",
    "a,,c",
    "a,b\r\nc,d\r\n",
    "\"Smith, John\",42\n\"multi\nline\",\"say \"\"hi\"\"\"\n"
]
for t in tests:
    print(repr(t), "=>", parse(t))

import csv
import io

print("empty string:", list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(""))))
print("only newline:", list(csv.reader(io.StringIO("\n"))))
print("two newlines:", list(csv.reader(io.StringIO("\n\n"))))
print("comma only:", list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(","))))
print("empty quote:", list(csv.reader(io.StringIO("\"\""))))
